title: Keep foreign evidence decisions out of native eligibility projections
outcome: Keep foreign evidence decisions out of native eligibility projections
acceptance: Retained foreign verification-applicability and acceptance-use originals remain inert across ordinary verify, projection rebuild and summary or eligibility reads; original canonical IDs and bytes are preserved.

A real transitive consumed-decision evidence retention regression stays healthy under verify_all and projection repair, exposes no foreign decision as a local eligible use, and preserves ordinary local decision behavior.

completion.summary: Foreign verification-applicability and acceptance-use decisions retained through evidence packs no longer reach this host's own projections or eligibility. Both owners rebuild and verify local decisions only, in both directions, and count a row for a foreign decision as extra. Foreign means listed in an immutable admission receipt's imported_objects, so rebuild order doesn't matter. A decision that returns to its host is not listed and stays native. eligible_for_on, acceptance qualify_on, both summaries and the replay paths refuse a foreign decision; canonical IDs and bytes are untouched. The regression test foreign_decisions.rs covers B's consumed decisions retained on A and then returned to B, under verify_all and repair_rebuildable_schema_on. Delivered in candidate 24815d44 (on master 0bd70a30, 98c1 plus the 6 owned files). Author batch on DL560 passed 4/4. Independent evaluation a44e0e7cafd942ac8e6ceb6699c81dc3 passed both criteria. Landing belongs to parent 12325 with the combined freeze.
